source_snapshot.procedure: Map an unresolved PCH port, inject generic `ce`, resume and inspect the selected PCH register.
source_snapshot.criteria: ERRCORSTS.RE bit 0x1 with normal health, front-panel off and optional BMC/UEFI logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic PCH logs do not identify port or RE bit.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires endpoint/port/X-Y mapping, CE-to-RE contract and Windows evidence.

old_problem: The physical PCH endpoint, Cscript port and pcieX/portY hierarchy were unresolved, and the package's generic CE token was not tied to the required Receiver Error bit.
disposition_reason: The source supplies a precise architectural acceptance signature—ERRCORSTS.RE=1—and continued-health behavior. ED-03 allows live PCH topology and version-specific token mapping as signed runtime inputs; ED-16 requires proof and endpoint isolation before injection. Mandatory Windows PCIe CE and device/link health complement the register evidence, so review completion does not require guessing X/Y or touching a boot-critical PCH device.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row 36, same-row AI fields, record 2439 and next pending row 37.
Preserved PCH Receiver Error separately from PCH completion-timeout/UCE and generic root-port CE.
Required an endpoint/BDF→PCH port→pcieX/portY mapping from the live platform.
Kept exact RE bit 0x1 as the decisive register result.
No mapping command, injection or register modification was executed.

test_case.purpose: Inject one correctable Receiver Error at an approved PCH-attached endpoint and prove ERRCORSTS.RE assertion with uninterrupted endpoint, link and host health.
required_package: Endpoint identity and boot/management dependency assessment
Supported package hash and CE-to-Receiver-Error contract
ERRCORSTS.RE, Windows WHEA/AER and device/link oracle
Abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration
test_case.test_command: Snapshot the approved PCH endpoint, selected ERRCORSTS, link and driver state; quiesce it if safe; then allow the FAE to run one vendor-proven Receiver-Error CE at the mapped port. Capture the full transcript, RE bit 0x1 and correlated Windows event, verify link/device/host health and indicator state, then restore settings.
test_case.expected_result: The intended port alone asserts ERRCORSTS.RE=0x1 and the matching Windows PCIe CE; the link, endpoint and host remain healthy, the front-panel light stays off, applicable management logs agree and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified PCH target mapping, package proof of Receiver Error, exact RE-bit and Windows evidence plus unchanged endpoint/link/host health. Generic PCH text, guessed X/Y, a different AER bit or essential-device disruption fails.
safety_gate: Identify boot, storage, network and management dependencies before approval.
Use current PCH map and independent console for risky endpoints.
One bounded injection; abort on wrong bit/target, escalation, link loss or service impact.
No automatic retry; preserve register evidence.
expected_evidence: Full injection transcript and ERRCORSTS.RE=1 capture
Windows PCIe CE, link/device/driver health and applicable management evidence
test_case.recovery: Stop on any unexpected effect, retain the selected register and OOB timeline, recover only through the approved endpoint/platform procedure, restore BIOS state and verify all PCH-attached services before another authorization.
